description: Five short prompts (~40-60 tokens input, 200 tokens max output). Covers code, explanation, and factual tasks.

prompts.text: Explain what a REST API is and describe the difference between a GET and a POST request. Give a concrete example of when you would use each.
What is the difference between supervised and unsupervised machine learning? Give one real-world example of a problem solved by each approach.
Write a Python function called is_palindrome that checks whether a given string is a palindrome. The function should ignore spaces and capitalization.
Name the three most significant human-caused contributors to climate change and briefly explain the mechanism by which each one traps heat in the atmosphere.
Explain how HTTPS protects data in transit. What role does TLS play, and what would an attacker be able to see if only HTTP were used instead?
